brief:
Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir posted an artificial intelligence-generated video promoting what he termed a "migration" plan for Gaza and the West Bank, Eye on Palestine reported. In the post, Ben-Gvir stated he would "lead and advance the immigration plan from Gaza and from" the West Bank in a future defense ministry role.

The video represents Ben-Gvir's latest public advocacy for displacement of Palestinians from the occupied territories, aligning with positions held by members of his far-right political faction.

title: Ben-Gvir promotes AI video backing Gaza, West Bank displacement plan
